Title: Modelling association football scores
Relevance rationale: Foundational modelling of team scoring strengths and match scores; a basis for later probabilistic score and outcome forecasts.

Title: Modelling association football scores and inefficiencies in the football betting market
Authors: Dixon, Mark J.; Coles, Stuart G.
Publication venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series C (Applied Statistics)
Relevance rationale: Introduced a influential dynamic score model and examined the relationship between statistical forecasts and betting-market prices.

Title: Prediction and retrospective analysis of soccer matches in a league
Publication venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series D (The Statistician)
Relevance rationale: Developed a dynamic Bayesian framework for team abilities and match forecasts, linking changing form to score prediction.

Title: Analysis of sports data by using bivariate Poisson models
Publication venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series D (The Statistician)
Relevance rationale: Shows how correlated team goal counts can be modelled jointly, improving probabilistic treatment of match scores.

Title: Regression models for forecasting goals and match results in association football
Relevance rationale: Evaluates regression approaches to forecasting goals and outcomes, providing a useful bridge between score modelling and practical prediction.

Title: A Bayesian hierarchical model for the prediction of football results
Relevance rationale: Uses hierarchical team effects to produce probabilistic forecasts and illustrates partial pooling across teams.

Title: Using ELO ratings for match result prediction in association football
Relevance rationale: Tests rating-based measures of team strength as predictors of match results and compares their forecasting value with other information.

Title: pi-football: A Bayesian network model for forecasting association football match results
Authors: Constantinou, Michael A.; Fenton, Norman E.; Neil, Martin
Relevance rationale: Combines football knowledge and statistical evidence in a Bayesian network to estimate match-result probabilities.

Title: A dynamic bivariate Poisson model for analysing and forecasting match results in the English Premier League
Publication venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series A (Statistics in Society)
Relevance rationale: Extends goal-based forecasting with time-varying team strengths and joint score modelling, directly addressing changing performance over a season.

Title: Prediction of the FIFA World Cup 2014 – A random forest approach with an emphasis on chosen team composition
Authors: Groll, Andreas; Schauberger, Gunther; Tutz, Gerhard
Relevance rationale: Applies machine learning to tournament forecasting and investigates whether team composition contributes useful predictive information.

Title: A machine learning framework for sport result prediction
Relevance rationale: Reviews and applies machine-learning approaches to sports-result prediction, helping situate football forecasting among broader modelling methods.

Title: Performance analysis in football: A critical review and implications for future research
Relevance rationale: Critically reviews football performance-analysis methods and their limitations, including the challenge of translating observed indicators into actionable insight.

Title: Match analysis in football: a systematic review
Authors: Sarmento, Hugo; Marcelino, Rui; Anguera, M. Teresa; Campaniço, Jorge; Matos, Nuno; Leitão, José
Relevance rationale: Synthesizes match-analysis research and its variables and methods, useful for understanding what performance measures can and cannot explain.

Title: Game-related statistics that discriminated winning, drawing and losing teams from the Spanish soccer league
Authors: Lago-Peñas, Carlos; Lago-Ballesteros, Joaquín; Dellal, Alexandre; Gómez, Miguel Ángel
Relevance rationale: Examines which match statistics distinguish outcomes in league play, illustrating how indicators relate to results while remaining sensitive to context.

Title: Big data and tactical analysis in elite soccer: future challenges and opportunities for sports science
Relevance rationale: Discusses the opportunities and practical limits of using large-scale data for tactical analysis and decision support in elite football.

Title: Data analytics in football: positional data collection, modelling and analysis
Authors: Memmert, Daniel; Lemmink, K. A. P. M.; Sampaio, Jaime
Relevance rationale: Reviews positional-data collection and analytical methods, connecting tracking data to tactical questions and performance assessment.

Title: Spatio-temporal analysis of team sports
Relevance rationale: Surveys computational approaches to spatial and temporal team-sport data, including methods relevant to football movement and tactics.

Title: A public data set of spatio-temporal match events in soccer competitions
Authors: Pappalardo, Luca; Cintia, Paolo; Ferragina, Paolo; Massucco, Emanuele; Pedreschi, Diego; Giannotti, Fosca
Relevance rationale: Describes an open event-data resource that supports reproducible analysis of match events, player actions, and team performance.

Title: Actions Speak Louder Than Goals: Valuing Player Actions in Soccer
Authors: Decroos, Tom; Bransen, Lotte; Van Haaren, Jan; Davis, Jesse
Publication venue: Proceedings of the 25th ACM SIGKDD International Conference on Knowledge Discovery & Data Mining
Relevance rationale: Introduces VAEP, a framework for valuing actions by their change in the probability of scoring or conceding, extending analysis beyond goals and assists.

Title: A goal scoring probability model for shots based on players' abilities in soccer
Relevance rationale: Models shot-level scoring probability while incorporating player ability, relevant to expected-goals estimation and separating chance quality from finishing outcomes.
